selected.title: Section 2(k) - Definition of employee
selected.explanation: The worker was employed on wages by an establishment, fitting the employee definition.

selected.title: Section 2(y) - Definition of wages
selected.explanation: Earned salary constitutes wages under the Code on Wages.

selected.explanation: Claim application for recovery of unpaid wages before the Gazetted Authority.
